projects.title: Coorg / Kodagu — All Destinations Script Library
projects.location: Bengaluru → Virajpet → Kushalnagar / Bylakuppe → Madikeri → Bhagamandala & Talakaveri → Bengaluru
projects.description:
YASH XPLORE · Corporate life. Weekend escapes. Bangalore to anywhere.

REVIEW-READY DESTINATION SCRIPT LIBRARY · 20–22 October 2026. This version contains a reusable script module for every unique destination in the user-submitted Coorg/Kodagu planner, plus the departure, road-trip, check-in, first-evening and return/outro scenes. Every destination module includes a voice-over, on-camera lines and separate shot checklist cards tagged for VlogScript Studio's script-type filtering.

IMPORTANT: These are OPTIONAL SCENE MODULES, not an instruction to visit every stop. The supplied planner's original time slots and day order are reproduced in scene subtitles/notes for reference, but the full lists are geographically spread and extremely tight; do not assume all stops fit a real day. Choose only the destinations actually visited, then reorder/move scenes to match the footage and route. Delete or ignore scenes for places you do not reach. Replace any [DESTINATION] placeholders in the outro with actual visited places only.

STYLE: warm, personal, cinematic Hinglish. Speak from what you actually see and experience. Avoid promising weather/views or claiming an activity happened unless it did. Confirm timings, bookings, access, road conditions and filming permission before going. Dubare Elephant Camp visitor/day-visit and elephant-interaction availability needs particular current confirmation; do not assume interaction is open. Several waterfalls/river edges and some listed late-evening slots need daylight, safe conditions and verified access.

CAMERA BASELINE: DJI Osmo Action 5 Pro, Normal 10-bit, WB 5500K, Auto exposure EV −0.3 as a starting point, landscape orientation. 4K/30 for talking, landscapes and static details; 4K/60 for selected walking/action; use higher frame rates sparingly. Hold still before and after pans. Safety first: do not operate camera while driving, cross barriers or approach unsafe water/edges.

scenes.title: Scene 01 — The Hook: Coorg Without a Fixed Checklist
scenes.subtitle: Opening story · Tease the places without promising that every stop will happen
scenes.purpose: Open with a feeling and a question; use only footage actually captured on the trip.
scenes.notes: EDITING NOTE: Open with 4–6 brief images from whatever locations you actually visit, then cut back to the start of the journey. Do not show a destination in a way that implies you reached it if you did not. Keep this scene adaptable to the final route.
scenes.voiceover: Coorg ke liye list banate waqt mujhe laga tha ki teen din mein kaafi saari jagah cover kar lunga. Phir ek simple si baat samajh aayi—trip ka maza har location ko tick karne mein nahi, balki un jagahon ko waqt dene mein hai jahan hum sach mein pahunch paate hain. Is baar plan mein hills hain, waterfalls hain, river ke paas kuch stops hain, aur coffee country bhi. Lekin final story wahi hogi jo road par actually happen karegi. Chalo, Bengaluru se nikalte hain aur dekhte hain Coorg humein kahan le jaata hai.
scenes.oncamera: Is trip ke liye maine kaafi jagahon ki list bana rakhi hai, lekin main har jagah ko forcefully cover nahi karna chahta. Jahan time, weather aur access allow karega, wahan rukenge. Aur jo experience hoga, wahi aapke saath share karunga. Chalo, nikalte hain.

scenes.title: Scene 02 — Tuesday: Leaving Bengaluru
scenes.subtitle: Trip opening · Film only while parked or with a safely mounted camera
scenes.purpose: Establish the familiar city-to-weekend-escape feeling.
scenes.notes: Safety: film the intro, bag loading, keys and seatbelt while parked. Do not hold or operate the camera while driving. For road footage, use a secure mount or ask a passenger.
scenes.voiceover: Work calendar, messages aur daily routine se thoda sa break lene ke liye kabhi-kabhi ek chhota road trip hi kaafi lagta hai. Aaj Tuesday hai, destination Coorg hai, aur mere paas teen din hain. Plan ready hai, lekin main chahta hoon ki journey ko bhi utna hi space doon jitna destinations ko. Abhi ke liye bas bags, camera aur Bengaluru se bahar nikalne ka excitement.
scenes.oncamera: Tuesday morning hai, aur aaj office ke tabs band karke road-trip mode on kar raha hoon. Coorg ke liye nikal raha hoon. Maine kaafi places shortlist ki hain, lekin exact route ko weather aur time ke hisaab se decide karunga. Dekhte hain is baar ka weekend kya story lekar aata hai.

scenes.subtitle: Journey montage · Keep the drive itself part of the story
scenes.purpose: Give the viewer a sense of movement and the transition away from the city.
scenes.notes: Use safe, mounted or passenger-operated footage only. Record a clean engine/road ambience clip only where safe. Add route or time overlay later only if verified from your actual drive.
scenes.voiceover: Road trip mein ek moment aata hai jab city ka noise dheere-dheere background mein chala jaata hai. Traffic abhi bhi hai, road bhi long hai, lekin mind already thoda slow hone lagta hai. Mujhe road trips ka yahi part pasand hai—destination tak pahunchne se pehle hi break feel hona start ho jaata hai. Aage ka plan flexible hai, toh aaj ka focus safely Coorg pahunchne aur stay settle karne par hai.
scenes.oncamera: Abhi hum drive par hain. Main moving car mein camera handle nahi karunga, toh road ke shots mounted camera se hi le raha hoon. Jaise-jaise hum city se bahar nikalenge, main aapko beech-beech mein journey ke moments dikhata rahunga.

scenes.voiceover: Har trip ka first evening kisi famous viewpoint par spend karna zaroori nahi hota. Kal list mein kaafi options hain, lekin subah ka final decision weather, access aur drive time dekh kar hi hoga.
scenes.oncamera: Aaj main zyada rush nahi karunga. Pehle settle ho jaate hain, kal subah fresh mind ke saath decide karenge ki list mein se kaun-si jagah practical hai. Trip hai, checklist competition nahi.

Never approach, feed, touch, call or provoke elephants independently; follow staff instructions and barriers. The original itinerary's 09:00 slot is not a confirmed reservation.
